summary: Energy Transfer LP filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a public offering of two series of junior subordinated notes due 2057. The filing is a routine debt issuance — no acquisition, divestiture, or special situation — and merely describes the terms (fixed-to-fixed reset rates, optional interest deferral, subordination, no listing). No deal terms are stated. The offering is a capital-markets transaction, not an event-driven special situation.
